body: Apparently, it's not reproducible with `dev_build=yes`. If you are testing, make sure to build with `dev_build=no`.

I figured since it's not spelled out directly here in this issue, it might be worth pointing out that this is rooted in stale pointers (stack addresses) being accessed, which technically leads to a crash/abort when running with `use_asan=yes`.
